subject: Re: Keystone webinar — request for attendee trial passes
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@keystoneevents.com>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 09:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Request: trial passes for Keystone webinar (July 23)

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the product looked great and we'd love to include Redwood as our recommended inference partner for the July 23 online summit. We have ~500 confirmed registrants and would like to provide each attendee with a 30-day trial pass (one-time promo code per registrant) so they can try the platform after the webinar.

A few specifics:
- Quantity: 500 unique single-use codes
- Duration: 30-day trial, standard starter quota (no extra tokens)
- Delivery: We can upload the registrant list (first name, last name, email) if you want codes pre-mapped; otherwise we can distribute codes on our end.
- Deadline: Ideally we need codes by Friday 16 July so we can include them in confirmation emails.

We're open to a co-marketing requirement (logo + short paragraph in event follow-up) if that helps with approval. Please let me know the process, any documents you need signed, and whether there's an approval window for a 500-code allocation.

Attached: preliminary attendee CSV (first 120 rows, full list coming).

Best,
Sarah Liu
Partnerships Manager
Keystone Events
Attachments: keystone_demo_attendee_list.csv (CSV, stub)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: monica.patel@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc:
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: trial passes for Keystone webinar (July 23)

Forwarding Keystone's ask — they want 500 30-day, single-use trial codes by 2026-07-16.

Operational constraints: our standard promo pool can cover this, but 500 full 30-day trials is a moderately large allocation for a single partner. Proposed options:
1) Approve full 500 x 30-day trials (co-marketing required). Estimated promo budget impact: ~USD 2.4k equivalent (based on average starter usage).
2) Split: 300 x 30-day + 200 x 7-day (reduces cost, keeps bulk visibility).

Questions for ops/legal: do we need an agreement / MSA addendum or will the co-marketing blurb suffice? Sarah mentioned they'll do logo & follow-up paragraph.

I'd like Ops to confirm provisioning timeline and Marissa to confirm we can allocate from the July promo pool without pushing other commitments.

Attachments: approval_MAT-2026-07-11.pdf (draft approval stub).

— Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Partner Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 09:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: trial passes for Keystone webinar (July 23)

Thanks for the context — I can approve the full 500 x 30-day trial grant with two conditions:
1) Keystone provides a co-marketing mention in both the webinar follow-up email and the landing page (we need a link and copy by end of day 16 July).
2) They sign a short SOW/one-pager covering intended use of trials and no automated scraping/competitive benchmarking. We can use our standard promo code T&Cs.

Ops notes: provisioning team can generate 500 single-use codes and pre-map them to the CSV if you send the final list by EOD 16 Jul. I'll open OPS-1245 and schedule provisioning for 17 Jul. There will be a small rate-limit flag if all codes redeem concurrently; we will rate-limit by IP window to protect latency.

I've attached a signed internal approval stub for Mateo to include in the partner email.

Attachments: approval_MAT-2026-07-11.pdf (signed stub)
Links: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/OPS-1245

— Monica Patel
Growth Ops Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@keystoneevents.com>, partnerships@keystoneevents.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 23:02:00 +00:00
Subject: Approved: 500 attendee trial codes for Keystone webinar (next steps)

Hi Sarah — great news: we're able to provide the 500 single-use, 30-day trial codes for the July 23 webinar. Thank you for offering the co-marketing placement — that satisfied our ops requirements.

Next steps:
- Please send the final registrant CSV (first name, last name, email) by EOD 2026-07-16 to mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai. Ops will pre-map codes to the file.
- We need a signed one-page agreement; I've included a DocuSign envelope link below for your convenience. If you prefer a PDF signed and uploaded, that works too.
- Expect code delivery on 2026-07-17 morning UTC. I'll also attach a small instructions file with redemption steps and TTL.

Deliverables attached: keystone_passcodes_instructions.txt (plain-text redemption instructions).
DocuSign (optional): https://app.docusign.com/Keystone-RDW/Envelope12345

If anything changes on your side with headcount or timeline, please flag immediately. Looking forward to a great event.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Partner Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachments: keystone_passcodes_instructions.txt (TXT, stub)
